stemMd: A drawer contains 6 left-handed gloves and 6 right-handed gloves, all the same size. Without looking, how many gloves must be drawn to guarantee a usable left-right pair?
explanationMd: The worst case is drawing all six gloves of one handedness first. The seventh must be of the other type, giving a pair. Six is insufficient, so seven is the minimum guarantee.

distractorRationale.a: The first two could have the same handedness.
distractorRationale.b: All six drawn could be left-handed or all right-handed.
